fingerprint.description: Stable hash for historical matching across code changes

artifacts.description: Generated output artifacts except audit.json itself, which cannot carry a stable self-hash.

stable_hash.description: SHA-256 over canonicalized artifact content with volatile generated_at/run_id fields removed for deterministic reproducibility checks.

shared_defs.schema.json.title: SharedDefinitions
shared_defs.schema.json.description: Shared type definitions used across multiple artifact schemas. Note: $id URLs are identifiers, not resolvable endpoints.

SourceRef.description: Reference to a source document that provides basis for artifact content.

id.description: Identifier of the source item, e.g., 'AC-1', 'BR-2', 'BUG-123'.

kind.description: Kind of source: spec (specification), ac (acceptance criteria), rule (business rule), bug (defect), auto_test (automated test), code_review (review comment), ops (operational data), confluence (Confluence page), jira (Jira issue), mock (mockup), memo (planning note), interview (user or stakeholder interview), metric (measurement or KPI).

excerpt.description: Optional excerpt of the source content for reference.

url.description: Optional URL to the source document.

Assumption.description: Assumption made when information is incomplete. Must be tracked for risk assessment.

severity.description: Severity level: low (minor impact), medium (some impact), high (significant impact), critical (blocking if wrong).

impact_on_coverage.description: How this assumption affects test coverage or approach.

Oracle.description: Oracle definition: how expected results are determined.

type.description: Oracle type: specified (in spec/AC), derived (from rules/old system), implicit (standard expectations), human (judgment needed).

refs.description: References to source for oracle, e.g., ['AC-1', 'BR-2'].

notes.description: Additional notes on oracle derivation or limitations.

ConfidenceLevel.description: Confidence in correctness: high (well-established), medium (reasonable basis), low (uncertain).

Priority.description: Risk-based priority: P0 (critical), P1 (high), P2 (medium), P3 (low).

TestView.description: Testing view: black (external UI), gray (limited diagnostic signals), white (implementation-level).

GateStatus.description: Gate decision: go (release ready), conditional_go (with conditions), no_go (blocked).

feature_spec.schema.json.title: FeatureSpec
feature_spec.schema.json.description: Normalized specification artifact for a feature under test. Produced by normalize_intake workflow step.

feature_id.description: Unique identifier for the feature, e.g., 'ORD-CANCEL-01'. Should be uppercase alphanumeric with hyphens.

title.description: Human-readable feature title in Japanese or English.

summary.description: Brief description of the feature's purpose and behavior. Optional but recommended.

actors.description: List of user roles or system actors involved in the feature, e.g., ['buyer', 'admin', 'system'].

acceptance_criteria.description: Acceptance criteria (AC) statements. Each should be testable and atomic. Required field.

business_rules.description: Business rules (BR) that constrain the feature behavior. Optional but important for coverage.

changed_areas.description: Code areas, services, or components affected by the change. Used for regression analysis.

source_refs.description: References to source documents (spec, AC, rules). Required for traceability.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made when information is missing. Each must have severity level.

risk_register.schema.json.title: RiskRegister
risk_register.schema.json.description: Risk assessment artifact with impact, likelihood, and priority ratings. Produced by assess_risk workflow step.

feature_id.description: Reference to the feature_spec feature_id being assessed.

risks.description: List of identified risks with scoring and priority.

priority.description: Risk priority: P0 (critical), P1 (high), P2 (medium), P3 (low).

trace_to.description: References to test cases or charters that cover this risk.

manual_case_set.schema.json.title: ManualCaseSet
manual_case_set.schema.json.description: Executable manual test cases and exploratory charters artifact. Produced by synthesize_manual_cases workflow step.

feature_id.description: Reference to the feature_spec feature_id these cases cover.

manual_cases.description: Scripted manual test cases with steps, expected results, and oracle references.

exploratory_charters.description: Exploratory testing charters for areas with weak oracles or high uncertainty.

platform_matrix.description: Platform coverage matrix for mobile testing: OS x lifecycle x network combinations.

role_matrix.description: Role-based access matrix: actor_role x target_role x action combinations.

ManualTestCase.description: Single scripted manual test case with complete execution instructions.

tc_id.description: Unique test case identifier, e.g., 'TC-001'. Should be sequential within feature.

title.description: Short descriptive title for the test case.

priority.description: Risk-based priority: P0 (critical), P1 (high), P2 (medium), P3 (low).

primary_view.description: Testing view: black (external UI), gray (limited diagnostic signals), white (implementation-level).

preconditions.description: Setup conditions required before execution, e.g., '注文状態=pending'.

steps.description: Sequential execution steps. Each should be actionable and specific.

expected_results.description: Observable expected outcomes after each step or at end.

oracle.description: Oracle definition: how expected results are determined.

type.description: Oracle type: specified (in spec), derived (from rules), implicit (standard), human (judgment).

refs.description: References to source for oracle, e.g., ['AC-1', 'BR-2'].

source_ref.description: Source reference: where the test case requirement comes from.

type.description: Source type: spec, requirement, acceptance criteria, risk, or user request.

estimate_minutes.description: Estimated execution time in minutes. Used for effort planning.

trace_to.description: Traceability to observations and risks, e.g., ['OBS-STATE-01', 'RISK-01'].

ExploratoryCharter.description: Exploratory testing charter for areas requiring investigation rather than scripted steps.

title.description: Short descriptive title for the charter's focus area.

scope.description: Scope or domain to explore, e.g., 'network loss and retry during cancellation'.

questions.description: Specific questions to answer during exploration.

estimate_minutes.description: Timebox for charter exploration in minutes.

PlatformMatrixEntry.description: Platform coverage entry for mobile testing: OS, lifecycle state, and network condition.

lifecycle.description: App lifecycle state: foreground, background, background_resume, or terminated.

network.description: Network condition: online, offline, or slow.

permission.description: Optional permission state for permission-related tests.

RoleMatrixEntry.description: Role-based access matrix entry: what action an actor can perform on a target.

actor_role.description: Role of the user performing the action.

target_role.description: Role of the target user being acted upon.

action.description: Permitted action: can_change, cannot_change, cannot_change_last (boundary), or invite_only.

ownership_context.description: Optional ownership context for multi-workspace scenarios.
